definitions.explanation: A fragrant flowering plant of the olive family, widely used in teas and perfumes. In Japan, jasmine tea (ジャスミンちゃ) is a popular drink, especially at Chinese restaurants.

examples.english: Jasmine tea has a nice fragrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{植|う}えた→植える：01210_ueru⟧ジャスミン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漂|ただよ}わせている→漂う：04356_tadayou⟧。
examples.english: The jasmine I planted in the garden is giving off a sweet fragrance.

notes:
USAGE:
Usually written in katakana. The most common context in everyday Japanese is ジャスミン⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧ (jasmine tea). The plant itself is also called {茉莉花|まつりか} in formal or botanical contexts, though this is rare in daily speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ジャスミン⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧ (jasmine tea)
- ジャスミン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (jasmine flower)
- ジャスミン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧ (jasmine fragrance)
- ジャスミン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精油|せいゆ} (jasmine essential oil)
